title: CCX / cmon Controller
description: Health of the cmon controllers in each CCX environment: availability, managed datastores, state counters, alarms, pod resources and exporter process.

list.name: environment
list.label: Namespace
list.description: CCX environment (namespace of the cmon controller).

panels.title: Controllers up
panels.description: cmon controllers reporting cmon_up == 1 in the selected environments.

panels.title: Controllers down
panels.description: cmon controllers whose exporter reports cmon_up == 0 (cmon daemon not answering).

panels.title: Exporter scrape failing
panels.description: cmon exporter endpoints (:9954) that Prometheus cannot scrape (up == 0).

panels.title: Datastores managed
panels.description: Datastores managed by the selected controllers (cmon_cluster_total).

panels.title: Critical alarms
panels.description: Open critical alarms across the selected controllers (cmon_alarms_critical_total).

panels.title: cmon container restarts
panels.description: Container restarts in cmon pods during the selected time range.

panels.title: Controllers
panels.description: One row per cmon controller: status, version, managed datastores, datastores down and open alarms.

targets.expr: count by (kubernetes_namespace) (max by (kubernetes_namespace, ClusterName) (cmon_cluster_up{kubernetes_namespace=~"$environment"}) == 0) or (count by (kubernetes_namespace) (max by (kubernetes_namespace, ClusterName) (cmon_cluster_up{kubernetes_namespace=~"$environment"})) * 0)

panels.title: Controller up/down history
panels.description: cmon_up per controller over time; red bands show when the cmon daemon was not answering its exporter. Shows the 15 controllers with the most downtime in the selected range.

panels.title: Datastores per controller
panels.description: Datastores each controller manages (cmon_cluster_total) and how many of them cmon reports as down (cmon_cluster_up == 0). Shows the 10 series with the highest peak in the selected time range.

targets.expr: topk_max(10, count by (kubernetes_namespace) (max by (kubernetes_namespace, ClusterName) (cmon_cluster_up{kubernetes_namespace=~"$environment"}) == 0) or (count by (kubernetes_namespace) (max by (kubernetes_namespace, ClusterName) (cmon_cluster_up{kubernetes_namespace=~"$environment"})) * 0))

panels.title: Datastores by state
panels.description: Datastores per cmon state across the selected controllers; the cmon_cluster_*_total series are current counts (gauges), not counters.

panels.title: State counts per controller
panels.description: Current datastore counts per state for each controller.

panels.title: Critical alarms
panels.description: Open critical alarms per controller (current count). Shows the 10 series with the highest peak in the selected time range.

panels.title: Backup-failed alarms
panels.description: Open backup-failed alarms per controller (current count). Shows the 10 series with the highest peak in the selected time range.

panels.title: Coredumps detected
panels.description: Coredumps detected by cmon per controller. Shows the 10 series with the highest peak in the selected time range.

panels.title: CPU usage
panels.description: CPU cores used per cmon pod container (cAdvisor). Shows the 10 series with the highest peak in the selected time range.

targets.expr: topk_max(10, sum by (namespace, container) (rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{namespace=~"$environment", pod=~"cmon-.*", container=~"cmon|cmon-ssh|cmon-exporter", job=~".*cadvisor.*"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Memory working set
panels.description: Memory working set per cmon pod container (cAdvisor), compared with its memory request. Shows the 10 series with the highest peak in the selected time range.

targets.expr: topk_max(10, sum by (namespace, container) (container_memory_working_set_bytes{namespace=~"$environment", pod=~"cmon-.*", container=~"cmon|cmon-ssh|cmon-exporter", job=~".*cadvisor.*"}))
topk_max(10, sum by (namespace, container) (kube_pod_container_resource_requests{namespace=~"$environment", pod=~"cmon-.*", resource="memory", container=~"cmon|cmon-ssh|cmon-exporter"}))

panels.title: Network I/O
panels.description: Bytes per second received (+) and transmitted (-) by each cmon pod (cAdvisor, pod-level). Shows the 10 series with the highest peak in the selected time range.

panels.title: Container restarts
panels.description: Restarts of cmon pod containers per interval (kube-state-metrics). Shows the 10 series with the highest peak in the selected time range.

panels.title: Last termination reason
panels.description: Why each cmon container last terminated (OOMKilled, Error, Completed), from kube-state-metrics.

targets.expr: max by (namespace, pod, container, reason) (kube_pod_container_status_last_terminated_reason{namespace=~"$environment", pod=~"cmon-.*"}) > 0

panels.title: cmon exporter process
Exporter scrape duration
panels.description: How long Prometheus takes to scrape the cmon exporter; slow scrapes usually mean cmon RPC is slow. Shows the 10 series with the highest peak in the selected time range.

panels.title: Exporter resident memory
panels.description: Resident memory of the cmon-exporter process. Shows the 10 series with the highest peak in the selected time range.

panels.title: Exporter CPU
panels.description: CPU cores used by the cmon-exporter process. Shows the 10 series with the highest peak in the selected time range.

panels.title: Goroutines
panels.description: Goroutines in the cmon-exporter process; steady growth indicates a leak. Shows the 10 series with the highest peak in the selected time range.

panels.title: Open file descriptors
panels.description: Open file descriptors of the cmon-exporter process as a share of its limit. Shows the 10 series with the highest peak in the selected time range.

targets.expr: topk_max(10, max by (kubernetes_namespace) (process_open_fds{app="cmon", kubernetes_namespace=~"$environment", instance=~".*:9954"} / clamp_min(process_max_fds{app="cmon", kubernetes_namespace=~"$environment", instance=~".*:9954"}, 1)))

panels.title: GC pause
panels.description: Average Go garbage-collection pause of the cmon-exporter process. Shows the 10 series with the highest peak in the selected time range.

targets.expr: topk_max(10, max by (kubernetes_namespace) (rate(go_gc_duration_seconds_sum{app="cmon", kubernetes_namespace=~"$environment", instance=~".*:9954"}[$__rate_interval]) / clamp_min(rate(go_gc_duration_seconds_count{app="cmon", kubernetes_namespace=~"$environment", instance=~".*:9954"}[$__rate_interval]), 1e-9)))

panels.description: Go runtime and process metrics of the cmon-exporter sidecar that serves :9954 (not the cmon daemon itself).
